fragment.source:
#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; uniform vec4 inputColor; in vec2 fragCoord; const float radius = 0.5; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float pixelDist = fwidth(dist) * 1.0; float smoothAlpha = 1.0 - clamp((dist - (radius - pixelDist)) / pixelDist, 0.0, 1.0); FragColor = vec4(inputColor.xyz, 1.0) * smoothAlpha; }

vertex.source:
#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec4 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec3 aPointInfo; uniform mat4 ProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; void main(void) { gl_Position = ProjectionMatrix * vec4(aPointInfo.x + aRectPoint.x * aPointInfo.z, aPointInfo.y + aRectPoint.y * aPointInfo.z, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.z, aRectPoint.w); }
